% !TEX encoding = UTF-8
%======================================================================
%  SDR Lab -- master preamble.  Do NOT edit per experiment.
%
%  Every document defines, BEFORE \input-ing this file:
%     \def\SDRdoctype{lab}            % lab | prelab | cheat
%     \def\SDRexpnum{1}               % experiment number (Latin digits)
%     \def\SDRexptitle{پایش طیف}        % Persian title
%     \def\SDRexptitleEN{Spectrum Monitoring}
%  and locates the project root with
%     \IfFileExists{../common/preamble.tex}{\def\SDRroot{..}}{\def\SDRroot{.}}
%  so the file compiles both from its own folder (TeXstudio, Overleaf,
%  latexmk -cd) and from the project root.
%
%  Engine: XeLaTeX (run twice: page totals and overlay graphics need it).
%======================================================================
\providecommand{\SDRroot}{..}
\providecommand{\SDRdoctype}{lab}
\providecommand{\SDRexpnum}{0}
\providecommand{\SDRexptitle}{}
\providecommand{\SDRexptitleEN}{}
\providecommand{\SDRbannerart}{}      % optional TikZ art for the lab banner

\input{\SDRroot/common/courseinfo}
\input{\SDRroot/common/packages}
\input{\SDRroot/common/fonts}
\input{\SDRroot/common/tikzlib}
\input{\SDRroot/common/style}
\input{\SDRroot/common/boxes}
\input{\SDRroot/common/commands}
